s1.desc: a bedroom with a wide bed under a pale duvet and a rounded yellow headboard

spans.view: with white pillows and a yellow bedside table at the right

beats.text: Polly sleeps on her side under the duvet with her eyes closed while Pax lies turned away at the left, only the back of his head showing
Polly rolls onto her back and stretches both flippers up in a wide yawn, her eyes still closed
Polly drops her flippers back down and blinks her eyes open
Polly rubs one eye with the tip of her flipper as she lies back on the pillow
Polly lowers her flipper and starts to turn her head toward Pax

spans.notes: locked f0-90 (ORB 0 px / scale 1.0000 vs f0 at f40, f80, f88). Storyboard has Pax waking, but the animation shows Polly waking; Pax is only the back of his head under the duvet at the far left (listed as partial, the span is kept for Polly).

quick pan left toward Pax and back (picture shifts +100 px at f104, back to 0 by f111); background diff starts at 90->91 and is ~0 again at 111->112. The duvet ripple (the fart) starts inside this span.

spans.view: with white pillows and a yellow bedside table at the right

beats.text: Polly stares with wide startled eyes and her flippers raised under her beak while the duvet ripples beside Pax
Polly rolls back onto her side away from Pax, still wide-eyed
Polly lies still on her side and peeks sideways with wide, startled eyes
Polly closes her eyes and lies still with her beak slightly open and a flipper tucked under her chin

spans.notes: locked f112-185 (ORB 0 px vs f0 at f112, f116, f120, f140, f185). The wobbling duvet edge f112-119 is the fart gag, drawn in style. Pax stays the back of his head at the far left.
